name: Facebook Community Sales OS - Social AIO Runtime
notes: Adds official Social AIO HTTP Relay POC using POST https://api.fbaio.org/call.
CLIENT_ID is taken from Social AIO > Automation > APIs > Connect and stored only in Apps Script Document Properties.
Import dialog now includes API Bridge controls: save Client ID, test relay, scan first Group page, and fetch first comment page.
Group POC uses get_list_fb_group_posts and feeds returned posts directly into the existing V1.7 import/dedupe pipeline.
Comment POC uses get_list_fb_comment and feeds returned comments directly into BÌNH LUẬN/CƠ HỘI.
POC intentionally limits scanning to the first page. Pagination and scheduled multi-group scans are gated on successful schema/latency acceptance.
Existing V1.7 daily metrics, import log, newest-first, media URLs, consistency audit, fast refresh and token saver remain unchanged.
